ios.desc:
ALLO makes teamwork simple and visual. Whether you're brainstorming ideas, managing projects, or sharing files, ALLO helps your team stay organized and connected.

Key Features:

1. Visual Collaboration: Turn ideas into action with an easy-to-use workspace.
2. File Organization: Upload and manage files effortlessly, all in one place.
3. Real-Time Teamwork: Collaborate live with chat, comments, and video.
4. Intuitive Design: Simple tools to keep your work flowing.

Perfect for marketing, design, and planning teams looking to stay productive and organized.

quotes.text:
We have been working on a project to make a better create workspace and platform for designers and artists.

Its been almost 2 years and we have come up with an application which provides a visual workspace for product development teams.

Using this application its easy to collaborate with team members for having brainstorming sessions , expressing thoughts and ideas over internet.

Our Main objective

Communication is key, so we want to improve the way team members communicate when collaborated for a project remotely to avoid any misunderstandings.

Reduce the number of meetings on a same issue, we want to reduce the redundancy, which i guess is an important factor if collaborating over internet.

Give a visual workspace which is very easy to use so that you can concentrate more on presenting your idea rather than the workspace itself.

Accurate communication on an idea or concept. Users can leave comments on any particular picture or an item inside a workspace, making it much more simpler and efficient to discuss.

Its available for free in the Appstore. https://itunes.apple.com/kr/app/beecanvas-organize-notes-on-whiteboard-notepad/id943284575?l=en&mt=8
